subject: Banking
title: The Unbanked in America
description: A quick win: understand The Unbanked in America.

hook.text: 4.5% of American households — 5.9 million — have no bank account.

buildup.text: The unbanked pay $40,000 extra over their lifetime in check-cashing fees, money orders, and prepaid card charges.

discovery.text: Common reasons: minimum balance requirements, distrust of banks, unpredictable fees, and previous bad experiences.

twist.text: Amazon, Walmart, and gas stations offer financial services to the unbanked.

climax.text: In America, being unbanked is expensive. The poorest people pay the most for basic financial services.

punchline.text: 5.9 million households. $40,000 lifetime penalty for not having a bank account.

quiz.question: How much extra do unbanked Americans pay over their lifetime?
